summary.en: Sequence ambiguity, statistical evidence and numerical robustness shape reliable proteomics analysis.
summary.zh: 序列歧义、统计证据与数值稳健性，共同影响蛋白组分析的可靠性。

en: Today's selections connect de novo sequencing benchmarks with quantitative-proteomics interpretation, FDR method selection and a software revision. Reading depth differs by item; no results were independently reproduced.
zh: 今天关注de novo测序评测、定量蛋白组解释、FDR方法选择与软件修订。各项阅读范围不同，均未开展独立复现。

papers.title: Limitations of de novo peptide sequencing in resolving sequence ambiguity

read_scope.en: Publisher-indexed abstract and selected results and methods; no reproduction.
read_scope.zh: 阅读出版方索引摘要及结果、方法重点；未复现。

commentary.en: A comparison of eight de novo sequencing models and three post-processing approaches finds that many shared errors arise from insufficient fragment-ion coverage, with limited gains from post-processing. This motivates explicit uncertainty handling rather than treating every full-sequence prediction as resolved. Conclusions depend on the selected datasets and database-search reference identifications.
commentary.zh: 对八种de novo测序模型与三类后处理方案的评测发现，共享错误多源于碎片离子覆盖不足，后处理改善有限。这提示研发应明确处理序列歧义，而非把完整序列预测都视作已解决的鉴定；结论受所选数据集和数据库搜索参考标签限制。

papers.title: ProteoAnalyst: Connecting biological context and peptide-level evidence in quantitative proteomics and phosphoproteomics

read_scope.en: Selected abstract, methods, results and discussion; supplements not read and no reproduction.
read_scope.zh: 阅读摘要、方法、结果及讨论部分；未读补充材料，未复现。

commentary.en: ProteoAnalyst connects statistical analysis, pathway and network interpretation with traceable peptide-level evidence. Across five benchmarks no workflow won uniformly; in HYE124, MSstats had an empirical FDR of 0.063 versus 0.100 for the default DIA workflow. Relative modification abundance must not be interpreted as modification occupancy.
commentary.zh: ProteoAnalyst连接统计分析、通路与网络解释及可追溯的肽段证据。五个基准中没有统一最优流程；HYE124中MSstats经验FDR为0.063，而DIA默认流程为0.100。相对修饰丰度不能直接解释为修饰占有率。

papers.title: A unified and practical taxonomy for false discovery rate control in omics research

read_scope.zh: 阅读出版方预览及图注。

commentary.en: This Comment organizes FDR procedures along two axes: theoretical versus numerical null distributions, and pooled versus feature-specific null construction. Its value is a framework for checking assumptions and choosing methods, not a new predictive model or a universal performance claim. The assessment here is limited to the preview and figure captions.
commentary.zh: 这篇Comment沿理论或数值零分布、汇总或特征特异零分布两轴梳理FDR程序。价值在于帮助检查假设并选择方法，不是新预测模型或普遍性能优势的证明；此处评估限于预览及图注。

papers.title: Protein Quantification in Mass Spectrometry-Based Proteomics

read_scope.en: Source comparison between iq 2.2.0 and 2.3.0; not run or reproduced. Alex A. Henneman is credited as a contributor.
read_scope.zh: 比较iq 2.2.0与2.3.0源码；未运行或复现。Alex A. Henneman署名角色为contributor。

commentary.en: iq 2.3.0 revises stopping and iteration rules in its existing numerical solver and changes missing-value handling and intensity parsing. These source-level changes warrant attention to numerical convergence and input validation, but they do not establish accuracy or speed gains. maxlfq-bit predates this release.
commentary.zh: iq 2.3.0修改既有数值求解器的停止和迭代规则，并调整缺失值处理与强度解析。源码变化提示应关注数值收敛与输入验证，但不能据此推断精度或性能提升；maxlfq-bit并非本版新增。
